physicalNotes: Radius 1.35 Jupiter radii from Mounzer et al. 2022 (2022A&A...668A...1M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract): 96,514.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.205 Jupiter masses (Mounzer et al. 2022, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2022A&A...668A...1M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
